gbm_population_evidence.quote: Pilot Study of Elemene in Treating Patients With Refractory Glioblastoma

candidate_evidence.quote: [DRUG] Elemene (other names: elemene injectable emulsion): Elemene injectable emulsion will be given for 80 mg/day in each 14-day cycle.
Elemene, isolated from the Chinese medicinal herb Curcuma wenyujin, was shown to exhibit antitumor activity in human and murine tumor cells in vitro and in vivo.

candidate_flag.reason: Elemene is a plant-derived compound; whether it is a licensed medicine (pharmacological) or a herbal product (excluded) is not settled by the record.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Relapsed/refractory disease confirmed by radiographic evidence after standard therapy.

role_evidence.quote: In control group,patients will receive TMZ-chemotherapy.In experimental group,patients will receive elemene injectable emulsion and TMZ-chemotherapy at the same time.

agents.drug_class_hint: plant-derived sesquiterpene (from Curcuma wenyujin), intravenous injectable emulsion marketed in China as an anticancer agent

flag.reason: Candidate status depends on whether elemene counts as a licensed medicine rather than a herbal product.

role_evidence.quote: Maintenance chemotherapy with TMZ will be administered at 150-200 mg/m2/day for 5 days in each 28-day cycle.

coder_notes: Randomized phase 2: TMZ alone ('contral group', registered as EXPERIMENTAL) vs elemene emulsion + TMZ; the control group works as control, so control_arm_from_other_arms = yes. Brief summary calls it a pilot phase I study while registry phase is PHASE2. Elemene is a Curcuma-derived natural product given IV; approval status outside the record (likely China-only), flagged for adjudication of candidate status.
